entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A mind mage Planeswalker who studies the hedrons, reads Jori's memories, and alters her mind to send her back to warn the camp while he goes to the Eye of Ugin.

entities.name: Jori En
entities.description: A tall merfolk scholar and guide who shares her knowledge of the leylines puzzle with Jace and is later mentally manipulated by him.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A Planeswalker who refuses to leave the encampment to go to the Eye.

entities.name: Kendrin
entities.description: A dead human scholar who led the Sea Gate team close to turning hedron magic into a weapon.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: An elf Planeswalker who left the encampment in the night on an important mission.

entities.name: Ayli
entities.description: A kor priestess of the Eternal Pilgrims who leads Jace and Jori to Ulamog as offerings.

entities.name: Ulamog
entities.description: An Eldrazi titan the Eternal Pilgrims worship as a god under the names Mangeni and Ula.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: The creatures swarming across Zendikar, extensions of the titans.

entities.name: The Eternal Pilgrims
entities.description: A cult of priests who worship Ulamog and offer travelers to it.

entities.name: The hedrons
entities.description: Stone monoliths tied to the Eldrazi as lures, bonds, and possible weapons.

entities.name: The Eye of Ugin
entities.description: The lynchpin of the hedron network in Akoum where Jace hopes to find his answer.

entities.name: Sea Gate
entities.description: The fallen city and now the target of Ulamog's advance.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: The plane threatened by the Eldrazi.

entities.name: Akoum
entities.description: The region where the Eye of Ugin lies.

events.summary: Jace meets Jori En, who offers her knowledge of the hedron research, and Jace reads her mind instead.
events.quote: "I have a better idea, if you're amenable."

events.summary: Jace sees Jori's memories of Kendrin's team and her death to the Eldrazi.
events.quote: She had died to the Eldrazi slaughter before she could pass on enough of what she knew.

events.summary: Jace says they must go to the Eye of Ugin; Gideon refuses to leave the encampment and Jace reveals Nissa has left.
events.quote: "We already have," said Jace. "Nissa left in the night."

events.summary: Jace and Jori set out for the Eye without Gideon and discuss whether Jace changed her mind or Gideon's.
events.quote: They rode out from the encampment—without Gideon.

events.summary: Eldrazi spawn attack Jace and Jori's coach, and the hurda panics.
events.quote: When the swarm of Eldrazi spawn crested the hill

events.summary: The kor woman Ayli rescues them, killing the hurda as bait, and leads them into a chasm.
events.quote: sliced through the hurda's neck with one of the sharp hooks.

events.summary: Ayli presents Jace and Jori as offerings to Ulamog, whom the Eternal Pilgrims worship.
events.quote: "Welcome, offerings, to the sanctuary," said Ayli

events.summary: Jace realizes Ulamog is drawn to concentrations of population and that Sea Gate and other refuges will become tombs.
events.quote: And those trusted landmarks would become—tombs.

events.summary: Jace uses an illusion to make the Pilgrims believe they are on fire, and he and Jori escape.
events.quote: "Stop," said Jace, and the man burst into flames.

events.summary: Jace tells Jori someone must warn Gideon that Ulamog is heading for Sea Gate while he goes on to the Eye alone.
events.quote: "Go back and warn them. I'm going to the Eye."

events.summary: Jace alters Jori's mind to make her think she chose to return, and she walks on toward Sea Gate, cursing him.

relations.note: Traveling companions whom Jace manipulates mentally.
relations.quote: Jace and Jori En exchanged another look

relations.note: Disagree on the mission but both seek to save Zendikar.
relations.quote: Maybe you're more alike than you think.
"We are the Eternal Pilgrims," Ayli intoned.

relations.note: Worship the titan as the god Mangeni, Ula.
relations.quote: The presence of the god Mangeni, whose second name is Ula

relations.note: Was with Kendrin when she died.
relations.quote: Jori putting her hand on Kendrin's forehead

relations.note: Tricks them with an illusion of fire.
relations.quote: Jace looked around at all the Eternal Pilgrims, and they, too, erupted in flames.
